description: This file defines the VoiceIDClient class, a specialized AWS client used to interact with the Amazon Voice ID service API. It specifies available methods for various Voice ID operations, including creating, describing, deleting, and listing resources, as well as managing fraudsters, speaker enrollments, and watchlists.

classes.name: VoiceIDClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, providing specific API methods for Amazon Voice ID service.

methods.name: associateFraudster
methods.description: Associates a fraudster with the Voice ID system.

methods.name: createDomain
methods.description: Creates a new Voice ID domain.

methods.name: createWatchlist
methods.description: Creates a new watchlist in Voice ID.

methods.name: deleteDomain
methods.description: Deletes an existing Voice ID domain.

methods.name: describeDomain
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific domain.

methods.name: describeFraudster
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific fraudster.

methods.name: describeFraudsterRegistrationJob
methods.description: Provides information about a fraudster registration job.

methods.name: describeSpeakerEnrollmentJob
methods.description: Details about a speaker enrollment job.

methods.name: disassociateFraudster
methods.description: Removes an association of a fraudster.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: updateDomain
methods.description: Updates an existing Voice ID domain.
